name: EXM_PERDIEM_POLICIES
description: This table contains information about per diem policies, including fixed rate rules and rates.

columns.name: PERDIEM_POLICY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of per diem policy.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: POLICY_NAME
columns.description: Name of a per diem policy.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of a per diem policy.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Status of a per diem policy.Values are from the lookup EXM_POLICY_STATUS.

columns.name: RATES_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates if the policy is created based on rates entered by the user or from rates uploaded from a Conus or OConus file.

columns.name: MEALS_RATE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Rates that are based on local rates or proportional rates.

columns.name: FREE_MEAL_DEDUCTION_CODE
columns.description: Type of deduction, by meal type and amount or by meal type and amount with percentage deductions over a specified limit.

columns.name: MEALS_AMOUNT_LIMIT
columns.description: Amount limit to determine deduction for free meal.

columns.name: DAY_TRAVEL_ELIGIB_HOURS
columns.description: Indicates the minimum hours of travel to be eligible for same day travel.

columns.name: ALLOW_ACTUAL_EXPENSE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if actual expenses are allowed instead of per diem.

columns.name: PERDIEM_POLICY_TYPE
columns.description: Type of travel for which a per diem policy is applicable, such as Generic, Domestic, or Foreign. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_POLICY_TYPE.

columns.name: TIME_BASED_RATE_MODEL_FLAG
columns.description: Reserved for future use. Indicates whether per diem policy rates vary based on travel time for each rate time period.

columns.name: RATE_FORMULA_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Formula calculation method for per diem allowance, such as Daily Rate, Sum Up Separate Rate Allowances, Daily Time Based Rate, or Sum Up Separate Rates -Time Based. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_RATE_FORMULA_METHOD.

columns.name: CURRENCY_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Currency option code indicating whether per diem policy rates in a policy are defined in a single currency or in a currency specific to locations.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the single currency in which rates for the policy are defined.

columns.name: ALLOW_RATE_CONVERSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a per diem policy allows the single currency rates defined in a policy to be converted to a different reimbursement currency.

columns.name: RATE_MULTIPLIER_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether the rate multiplier is number of days or nights when the per diem policy calculation method is set to Daily Rate. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_MULTIPLIER.

columns.name: RATE_INCLUDE_MEALS_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the per diem allowance defined for the policy includes meals.

columns.name: RATE_INCLUDE_ACCOM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the per diem reimbursement defined for the policy includes accommodations.

columns.name: RATE_INCLUDE_OTHER_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the per diem reimbursement defined for the policy includes other expenses.

columns.name: MEAL_RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating meal allowance type for a policy, such as Daily Rate, Rates By Meal Type or Rates by Number of Meals. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_MEAL_RATE.

columns.name: MEAL_INCL_INCIDENTAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the meals allowance also includes incidental expense charges.

columns.name: MEAL_DEDUCTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the per diem policy deducts free meals from the calculated meals allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_DEDUCTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this per diem policy deducts free accommodations from the calculated accommodation allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_FREE_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the per diem policy permits free accommodations only allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_MIN_NIGHT_HOURS_STAY
columns.description: Minimum number of hours of stay to qualify for accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ENABLED_LOCATION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether per diem policy rates vary by location type, such as geographical location or zone.

columns.name: LOCATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup type that indicates policy rates vary by geographical locations.

columns.name: ZONE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup type that indicates policy rates vary by zones.

columns.name: ENABLED_ROLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether per diem allowances vary based on a role type such as, job management level or salary threshold.

columns.name: ROLE_CALC_METHOD
columns.description: Calculation method for role based allowances for a per diem policy, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: POLICY_ROLE_CODE
columns.description: Role type by which per diem allowances vary, such as job management level or salary.

columns.name: ENABLED_SEASON_RATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether accommodation rates vary by season when accommodations are included in per diem.

columns.name: ENABLED_ACCOM_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether per diem policy rates vary by type of accommodation.

columns.name: ENABLED_LONG_TERM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether per diem policy has rules or rates defined for long-term travel.

columns.name: ENABLED_WEEKEND_HOLID_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether per diem policy has rules or rates defined for weekend and holiday travel.

columns.name: MIN_TRIP_DURAT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this policy has a minimum trip duration for per diem eligibility.

columns.name: MIN_DURATION_HOURS
columns.description: Minimum travel time hours to qualify for per diem or meals rate.

columns.name: MIN_DURATION_MINUTES
columns.description: Minimum travel time minutes to qualify for per diem or meals rate.

columns.name: MIN_DISTANCE_FROM_HOME
columns.description: Minimum travel distance from home to qualify for per diem rate.

columns.name: MIN_DISTANCE_FROM_OFFICE
columns.description: Minimum travel distance from office to qualify for per diem rate.

columns.name: WITHIN_EMPLOYEE_CITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a policy allows travel within the employee's home city to qualify for per diem or meals allowance.

columns.name: MEALS_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for per diem or meals allowances, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: MEALS_DEDUCTION_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating meals deduction type for a per diem policy, such as Daily Meals Deduction, Deduction by Meal Type, or Deductions by Number of Meals. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_MEAL_DEDUCTION.

columns.name: MEALS_DEDUCT_CALC_METH_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for meals deductions, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: BREAKFAST_ELIG_START_HOUR
columns.description: Starting time hour for breakfast to qualify for a breakfast allowance.

columns.name: BREAKFAST_ELIG_START_MINUTE
columns.description: Starting time minutes for breakfast to qualify for a breakfast allowance.

columns.name: BREAKFAST_ELIG_END_HOUR
columns.description: Ending time hour for breakfast to qualify for a breakfast allowance.

columns.name: BREAKFAST_ELIG_END_MINUTE
columns.description: Ending time minute for breakfast to qualify for a breakfast allowance.

columns.name: LUNCH_ELIG_START_HOUR
columns.description: Starting time hours for lunch to qualify for a lunch allowance.

columns.name: LUNCH_ELIG_START_MINUTE
columns.description: Starting time minutes for lunch to qualify for a lunch allowance.

columns.name: LUNCH_ELIG_END_HOUR
columns.description: Ending time hour for lunch to qualify for a lunch allowance.

columns.name: LUNCH_ELIG_END_MINUTE
columns.description: Ending time minutes for lunch to qualify for a lunch allowance.

columns.name: DINNER_ELIG_START_HOUR
columns.description: Starting time hours for dinner to qualify for a dinner allowance.

columns.name: DINNER_ELIG_START_MINUTE
columns.description: Starting time minutes for dinner to qualify for a dinner allowance.

columns.name: DINNER_ELIG_END_HOUR
columns.description: Ending time hours for dinner to qualify for a dinner allowance.

columns.name: DINNER_ELIG_END_MINUTE
columns.description: Ending time minutes for dinner to qualify for a dinner allowance.

columns.name: MINIMUM_REIMBURSEMENT
columns.description: Minimum per diem or meals allowance that overrides meals deduction rules to ensure employees are guaranteed a minimum reimbursement amount after deductions.

columns.name: ACCOM_REQ_MEALS_ELIGIB_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a per diem policy requires an employee to meet the meals allowance criteria before he is eligible for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_RATE_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for accommodations allowance, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: ACCOM_DEDUCT_CALC_METH_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for accommodations deduction, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: ACCOM_MIN_TRIP_DURAT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether there is a minimum trip duration requirement before an employee is eligible for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_MIN_DURATION_HOURS
columns.description: Minimum travel time hours for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_MIN_DURATION_MINUTES
columns.description: Minimum travel time minutes for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_ELIGIB_START_HOUR
columns.description: Starting night time hour for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_ELIGIB_START_MINUTE
columns.description: Starting night time minutes for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_ELIGIB_END_HOUR
columns.description: Ending night time hours for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: ACCOM_ELIGIB_END_MINUTE
columns.description: Ending night time minutes for trip to qualify for an accommodations allowance.

columns.name: OTHERS_ELIGIB_CRITERIA_CODE
columns.description: Eligibility criteria for receiving an incidental allowance, such as None, Meets Meals Eligibility, or Meets Meals and Accommodations Eligibility. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_ELIG_CRITERIA.

columns.name: OTHERS_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for an incidental allowance, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: HOLIDAY_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for weekend and holiday allowances, such as Rate or Percentage. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: WEEKEND_DAY1_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the first weekend day for a specific geographic region. For example, the first weekend day for a specific geographic region may not be Saturday as it is in the United States.

columns.name: WEEKEND_DAY2_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates the second weekend day for a specific geographic region. For example, the first weekend day for a specific geographic region may not be Sunday as it is in the United States.

columns.name: LONG_TERM_CALC_METHOD
columns.description: Calculation method for long-term travel allowances. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: SPECIFIC_FIRST_LAST_DAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether a per diem policy has specific rates for first day and last day.

columns.name: TIME_PERIOD_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates time period boundaries for a per diem day, such as Midnight to Midnight or Start Time Plus 24 Hours. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_TIME_PERIOD.

columns.name: TIME_CALC_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Calculation method for time threshold allowances, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.

columns.name: TIME_ALLOW_SAME_DAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this per diem policy will allow same day trip.

columns.name: TIME_SAME_DAY_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Code that indicates whether specific same day travel rates are applicable to trips less than 24 hours or to trips without an overnight. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_SAME_DAY_RULE.

columns.name: TIME_SAME_DAY_CALC_METHOD
columns.description: Calculation method for same day travel time threshold allowances, such as Rate, Percentage, or Spreadsheet. Values are from the lookup ORA_EXM_PERDIEM_CALCMETH.
